study.research_problem: Infected long-bone nonunion and defects require simultaneous infection control, stable fixation, length restoration, and bone regeneration, yet Ilizarov bone transport imposes prolonged external fixation and substantial complications/burden.
study.exact_gap: Clinical experience with debridement, bone transport, grafting, intramedullary conversion, vascularized fibula, and Taylor frames needed to be organized around different combinations of infection, nonunion, defect length, and treatment burden.
study.objective_or_hypothesis: Narratively review the development and clinical applications of Ilizarov-based strategies and propose combination/digital approaches that might reduce fixation time, complications, and patient burden.
study.study_design: Search-informed narrative review of 22 predominantly retrospective clinical series/case-control reports selected from 793 records; no formal risk-of-bias, certainty, or meta-analytic method.
study.sample_or_model: Published clinical cohorts/series of infected tibial/femoral/humeral nonunion and segmental defects treated with heterogeneous external fixation, transport, grafting, nails, fibular grafts, antibiotics, and Taylor frames.
comparators: Ilizarov versus/combined with intramedullary fixation, bone graft, vascularized fibula, or Taylor frame
Infection eradication versus fracture union versus ASAMI bone/function outcomes
External-fixation duration and defect/transport distance versus complications/patient burden
No empirical comparison for proposed 3D-print/digital strategies
method_spine: Describe tension-stress/distraction-osteogenesis rationale and external-fixator advantages/burdens.
Separate infected nonunion, infected defect, and combined nonunion-plus-defect scenarios.
Extract union, transport distance, treatment time, infection recurrence, function, and complications from heterogeneous series.
Discuss strategy combinations intended to reduce fixation burden.
Keep digital/3D-printing concepts as future hypotheses rather than current evidence.

verification: A screening count and table of 22 studies improve traceability, but inclusion/exclusion rules conflict and reviewer/search procedures are not reproducible (S002:C02-S002:C05).
validation: Historical case series provide clinical feasibility signals; they do not validate causal superiority or one universal treatment algorithm.
sensitivity: No risk-of-bias, heterogeneity, outcome-definition, leave-one-out, publication-bias, or subgroup sensitivity analysis was conducted.
application_prediction: Patient-specific printed frames/templates, remote modeling, and printed antibiotic constructs are proposals without included empirical validation (S007:C01-S007:C03).

primary_outcomes: Included reports describe union rates often above 90% but with wide variation, incomplete outcomes, diverse defect lengths/techniques, and mostly retrospective designs (S002:C03-S002:C05).

An early approach achieved union but one cited series reported 100% infection recurrence, motivating radical debridement before transport and showing that union and infection control are separate outcomes (S004:C01-S004:C02).
Nail conversion or grafting may reduce external-fixation time in selected reports, but indications/timing remain controversial and comparative evidence is weak (S004:C02-S004:C04; S006:C01-S006:C02).

Large defects can unite, yet transport distance and prolonged fixation contribute to docking problems, deviation, pin loosening/infection, stiffness, psychosocial burden, persistent nonunion, and occasional amputation (S005:C01-S005:C03).
All 3D-print/digital benefits appear in the prospects section as suggested applications rather than study results (S007:C01-S007:C03).
study.highest_evidence_level_reached: Heterogeneous low-level clinical observational evidence and expert narrative; no pooled comparative effect, formal certainty, or tested digital/AM intervention.

argument_map.central_claim: Ilizarov-based bone transport is a versatile limb-reconstruction option with substantial clinical experience, but its benefit must be reported together with infection recurrence, external-fixation time, complications, function, and selection context; proposed digital/3D-print integration remains untested.
data: Table-level case counts, defect/transport lengths, union, ASAMI-type outcomes, and healing durations (S002:C03-S002:C05).
Narrative examples include successes, failures, infection recurrence, complications, and combination approaches (S004:C01-S006:C03).
argument_map.warrant: For prolonged complex reconstruction, a high union percentage is clinically incomplete unless infection control, limb function, burden, complications, salvage/amputation, and treatment duration are jointly considered.
backing: The review itself repeatedly emphasizes fixation duration, discomfort, pin infection, stiffness, and psychological burden as central limitations (S003:C02-S003:C03; S004:C02; S006:C02).
argument_map.qualifier: Feasibility and practice-pattern evidence from selected, mostly retrospective heterogeneous cohorts.
rebuttals_or_boundaries: Study-selection criteria contradict one another about reviews and do not explain how 771 records were excluded (S002:C02-S002:C03).
No standardized definitions, independent appraisal, confounder control, or pooled denominators.
Large observed union rates may reflect selection, co-interventions, survivor/reporting bias, and inconsistent follow-up.
Failure/infection recurrence and complication reporting is uneven.
The review's 3D-printing propositions are not evidence from the 22 clinical reports.

measured: The review directly records search counts and transcribes study-level cases, technique, defect/transport distance, union, scores, and time; no new patient outcomes are measured (S002:C02-S002:C05).
inferred: Ilizarov is called a gold standard and combination approaches are inferred to reduce time/complications from nonrandomized series (S003:C02; S004:C03; S007:C01).
Tension-stress and regeneration are used as mechanistic explanations, not tested within this review (S002:C01-S002:C02).
Digital modeling/printing is inferred to improve accuracy, prognosis, infection control, and fixation duration (S007:C02).
recommended: Individualize debridement, transport, graft timing, fixation conversion, and frame choice; prospectively compare comprehensive outcomes and test digital strategies before recommending them (S004:C03-S007:C03).
proxy_to_outcome_bridges: Fracture union is not equivalent to eradicated infection, good limb function, or acceptable patient burden.
ASAMI bone and function categories should not be collapsed into one success rate.
External-fixation time and defect length are exposure/burden descriptors, not treatment efficacy alone.
A plausible CAD/3D-print workflow is not a clinically validated intervention.
Retrospective case-series proportions are not comparative treatment effects.
overclaim_risks: 'Efficacy well verified' and 'internationally recognized gold standard' are stronger than the appraised evidence process supports (S002:C02; S007:C01).
Several 100% union reports are presented without equally standardized complications, infection recurrence, or uncertainty (S004:C01-S005:C03).
Keywords/automated cues imply 3D printing and porous scaffolds, but these appear only as future proposals (S007:C01-S007:C03).
The review's inclusion criteria admit reviews while exclusion criteria exclude them, weakening selection transparency (S002:C02-S002:C03).

section_moves.execution: Clinical examples jointly discuss union, infection, transport/fixation time, functional scores, docking/graft procedures, complications, and amputation (S004:C01-S006:C02).
section_moves.transferable_principle: For reconstructive treatment, synthesize biological success, infection control, mechanical/functional result, treatment time, complication burden, and patient experience in the same evidence row.
section_moves.failure_mode: A 100% union rate can coexist with recurrent infection, long fixation, stiffness, or poor function.

section_moves.move: Organize heterogeneous studies by clinical problem and decision
section_moves.execution: The review separates infected nonunion, infected defects, and combined periarticular cases, then discusses graft/nail/frame choices (S004:C01-S006:C03).
section_moves.transferable_principle: When pooling is inappropriate, structure evidence by decision-relevant phenotype, failure mechanism, and co-intervention rather than by headline success rate.
section_moves.failure_mode: Do not compare techniques across radically different defect lengths and infection states as if exchangeable.

section_moves.execution: The final section lists CT/CAD, printed frames/templates, remote monitoring, and antibiotic constructs as assumptions/future applications (S007:C01-S007:C03).
section_moves.transferable_principle: Write future technology as problem→proposed mechanism→required validation→patient-important endpoint; never mix it into the evidence table as an achieved result.
section_moves.failure_mode: A detailed workflow can still be entirely hypothetical.

section_moves.move: Audit internal consistency of selection rules
section_moves.execution: Reviews are simultaneously listed as eligible and excluded (S002:C02-S002:C03).
section_moves.transferable_principle: Before trusting a review, reconcile eligibility, flow counts, study types, dates, and duplicates; flag contradictions rather than silently treating the corpus as systematic.
section_moves.failure_mode: A flow diagram alone does not make selection reproducible.

author_reported: Ilizarov requires complex/long treatment, burdens patients, and causes pin infection/loosening, nonunion, stiffness, and psychosocial problems; it is unsuitable for some compliance/anatomical contexts (S003:C02-S003:C03; S007:C01).
reader_identified: Search strategy lacks reproducible syntax/reviewer procedures; eligibility is contradictory and no risk-of-bias/certainty appraisal is provided.
Mostly retrospective series with heterogeneous diagnoses, lengths, sites, techniques, co-interventions, scores, and follow-up.
No confidence intervals, standardized adverse events, comparative adjustment, meta-analysis, or publication-bias assessment.
Some table labels/data are incomplete or ambiguous.
Digital/AM section is expert speculation, not evidence synthesis.
likely_bias_direction: Positive case-series publication and selective reporting likely inflate apparent union/effectiveness.
Incomplete burden and failure reporting likely favors intervention conclusions.
Clinical heterogeneity can create misleading cross-study rankings in either direction.
limitations.scope_boundary: Use this article as a clinical problem/decision map and source-finding aid, not as high-certainty comparative evidence or proof that 3D-printed/digital Ilizarov strategies improve outcomes.

writing_capability_candidates.capability: For complex reconstructive procedures, report a benefit-burden bundle that keeps union, infection eradication, function, treatment duration, complications, psychosocial load, salvage, and amputation distinct.
writing_capability_candidates.manuscript_use: Clinical evidence tables, Results synthesis, and Discussion.
writing_capability_candidates.counterexample_or_boundary: A high union percentage is not comprehensive success when infection or burden remains high.

writing_capability_candidates.capability: Distinguish observed clinical evidence, biomechanical rationale, expert recommendation, and future digital/AM concept in every review paragraph.
writing_capability_candidates.counterexample_or_boundary: A keyword, mechanistic explanation, or detailed CAD workflow is not an evaluated intervention.

writing_capability_candidates.capability: Audit review-corpus construction for internally inconsistent eligibility and resist converting low-level heterogeneous series into comparative certainty.
writing_capability_candidates.counterexample_or_boundary: A numbered flow and study table do not compensate for contradictory rules or absent bias assessment.

critical_weaknesses: Contradictory selection rules and no bias assessment.

summary_zh: 这篇文章最有用的不是其‘金标准’判断，而是复杂重建论文的结局框架：骨愈合、感染清除、肢体长度/功能、外固定时间、并发症、心理负担、再手术和截肢必须分列。文中甚至出现愈合同时感染复发率很高的例子，说明一个成功率不能代表整体成功。检索虽有流程图和22篇表格，但纳入与排除条件对综述相互矛盾、没有偏倚评价，主要证据也是回顾性病例系列。3D打印只在展望中出现，必须标为未来假设，不能被关键词或自动分类升级成已验证技术。
reader_notes: Primary Codex reader reviewed every non-reference packet section.
The additive-manufacturing, porous-scaffold, and animal cues are false for the review itself.
This paper is useful for decision taxonomy but unsuitable as a high-certainty effectiveness source.
